title: Loyalty Rate Asked of a Guest on the Keyturn Guest Protection Plan Fee
content:
The loyalty rate is the share of the protection fee a guest with a record on the marketplace is asked for, taken
on the fee the level's basis produces for the charged days and taken before that fee is held at the level's floor
or under the trip ceiling. It is read from the guest's own trip ledger on the Keyturn Trip Booking, in which a
trip charged at the trip base rate appears as a base rate charged and a mileage overage as a mileage overage
charged.

- Where the guest has been charged the trip base rate on 4 trips or more over the last twelve months and the
  guest's trips carry no mileage overage charged in that time, the loyalty rate is 0.90 of the fee, which is
  ninety hundredths of it.
- Where the guest has been charged the trip base rate on 2 trips or more over the last twelve months and the
  guest's trips carry no mileage overage charged in that time, the loyalty rate is 0.94 of the fee.
- In every other case the loyalty rate is 1.00 of the fee, the whole of it.

## The combinations in full

| Trips charged the trip base rate in the last twelve months | Mileage overages charged in that time | Loyalty rate |
|---|---|---|
| 4 or more | None | 0.90 |
| 4 or more | One or more | 1.00 |
| 2 or 3 | None | 0.94 |
| 2 or 3 | One or more | 1.00 |
| Fewer than 2 | Either | 1.00 |

The counts are met at the figure itself: a guest charged the trip base rate on exactly 4 trips in the period,
with no mileage overage charged, is asked 0.90; on exactly 3 such trips, 0.94; on exactly 2, 0.94; on exactly
1, the whole of the fee.

## Worked on a hypothetical ledger

A guest whose Keyturn Trip Booking ledger shows 6 trips charged at the trip base rate over the last twelve
months and one mileage overage charged five months ago is asked the whole of the fee, because the mileage
condition is not met at either of the two rates below 1.00.

Take instead a hypothetical ledger of 3 such trips and no mileage overage charged in the period, on a fee of
500.00 USD produced by the level's basis for the charged days. The rate asked is 0.94, so 470.00 USD is reached,
and it is that figure, and not the 500.00 USD the basis produced, that goes on to be held at the level's floor
and under the trip ceiling.
